lines.name: same-position share: of two agents in the same situation, how often they act measurably differently
lines.why: the author's own number for very different behaviours surviving (2026-10-24), with its line at half: two agents more often act differently than alike

lines.name: Gini of the tokens, over the Gini of tokens dealt out at random at the same mean holding
lines.why: with no baseline, chance draws the line: a world more even than a random deal has something flattening it; tokens dealt out at random, one at least, at a mean of m an agent have a Gini of (m - 1) / (2m - 1), so the line moves with the world's own riches (0.40 at 3 tokens an agent, 0.46 at 7, 0.47 at 10)

dropped.genotypes_alike: a genotype is renewed by every mutation, so how many agents share one says how seldom brains mutate, not how differently agents act; the same-position share measures that (in round 3 no world came near the line: at most 26% of a world's agents shared a genotype)
dropped.gini: drawn at B2's most even world of Experiment 16, a baseline the screen no longer compares with; the proposal's line for not too even is drawn by chance instead
